sentences.en: The journalist was too upset to distinguish vice from virtue.
sentences.zh: 这位记者情绪太激动了，无法分辨是非。

sentences.en: The driver could not distinguish the signal in the fog.
sentences.zh: 司机在雾中无法辨认信号。

sentences.en: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished achievements.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名记者的职业生涯充满了杰出的成就。

senses.zh: 显扬自己, 使自己扬名

mnemonic: 词根记忆：di(s)（分离）+stingu（刺）+ ish→将刺挑出来→区别，辨别
